boundary: Existence and uniqueness of such an involution for every arbitrary symplectic spread are not proved.

proved.candidate_characterization: {A,sigma(A)} for spreads carrying the linewise fixed-point-free involution
proved.desarguesian_sigma: nonsquare similitude g with g^2=mu I for odd q

theorem: For any spread carrying a fixed-point-free linewise involution sigma, residual candidates are exactly the line orbits {A,sigma(A)}, giving q(q^2+1)/2 candidates supported on a 1/q fraction of residual edges with multiplicity q. A nonsquare similitude constructs sigma for the associated Desarguesian symplectic spread for every odd q. At q=3 the spread seed is not maximal, but its residual support deficiency forbids completion.
